description: Implement in-memory token caching with TTL-based expiration in AbdmAuth to eliminate redundant gateway /sessions calls on every ABDM API request. ABDM sessions endpoint returns accessToken with expiresIn (seconds). Cache token with 60-second buffer before true expiry.
steps: 1. Add private fields to AbdmAuth class: cachedToken (string | null), tokenExpiresAt (number | null), and EXPIRY_BUFFER_SEC constant (60)
2. Modify getAccessToken() to check cache: if cachedToken exists and Date.now() < tokenExpiresAt, return cached token immediately
3. On cache miss or expiry, fetch new token from gateway POST /v0.5/sessions, extract accessToken and expiresIn from AbdmSessionResponse
4. Calculate tokenExpiresAt = Date.now() + (expiresIn * 1000) - (EXPIRY_BUFFER_SEC * 1000), store in cache fields
5. Add clearCache() method (public) for testing/manual invalidation: sets cachedToken and tokenExpiresAt to null
6. Update AbdmSessionResponse interface in backend/src/types/abdm.types.ts if expiresIn field doesn't exist (verify first)
acceptance_criteria: AbdmAuth.getAccessToken() makes only ONE gateway /sessions call for multiple sequential requests within the same token lifetime
Token is refreshed automatically when current time exceeds tokenExpiresAt
clearCache() method allows manual cache invalidation
TypeScript typecheck passes with no errors
verification: Run `npm run typecheck` from backend/ directory - must pass with zero errors
Manual verification: Add console.log in getAccessToken() before fetch call. Call any ABDM API route twice in succession - should see only one 'fetching token' log
Check AbdmAuth.ts file length remains under 100 lines (Rule 20)
findings: Token caching implemented successfully. Added private fields (cachedToken, tokenExpiresAt, EXPIRY_BUFFER_SEC=60). getAccessToken() checks cache validity before fetching. clearCache() method added for manual invalidation. File length: 93 lines (under 100-line limit). TypeScript typecheck passes. AbdmSessionResponse.expiresIn field already existed in abdm.types.ts.
